PoH hash append and mixin functions using SHA-256.

# Purpose
This file defines two helper functions for updating a proof-of-history hash value in place. [`fd_poh_append`](<#fd_poh_append>) advances the current hash by applying `fd_sha256_hash_32_repeated` to the buffer `poh` for `n` steps, then returns the same buffer. [`fd_poh_mixin`](<#fd_poh_mixin>) combines the current `poh` hash with a second 32-byte value `mixin` by hashing both values with `fd_sha256`, then stores the result back into `poh` and returns it.
